releaseNotes.summary: Audio Mixer V2 adds native Windows desktop and microphone capture, reliable mixed-audio recording, improved metering, and safer output levels.
changes: Added native WASAPI desktop loopback and microphone capture routed into a 48 kHz stereo program bus.
Added Desktop Audio and Microphone mixing with volume, mute, logarithmic dBFS meters, and green, yellow, and red level zones.
Improved multichannel downmixing and limiter behavior to prevent clipping and audible distortion.
Improved WAV recording continuity so recordings retain their beginning, ending, and elapsed timeline, with safe .part-file finalization.
Added bounded mixed-audio output queueing and automated audio routing and recording-continuity tests.
Documented that mixed PCM is queued for output while RTMP audio encoding and transmission remain future work.
